citation.authors: Collins M, Yu J et al

cited_by.title: Braids, twists and extensions: tension, how long, itch

record.population: Review of documented cases of contact dermatitis from synthetic hair and related practices
record.finding: Synthetic hair extensions are known to cause contact dermatitis through allergens such as acrylates and disperse dyes. Scalp contact dermatitis can show up as itch, thinning or an eczema-like rash and is easily misdiagnosed. Braiding, wigs and the products used to maintain them are discussed.
record.note: Case reports, not a prevalence study; the abstract does not name which glues or products.
